dedupe_keys.name: usługi uzytecznosci publicznej i słuzby panstwowe

description: Usługi użytecznosci publicznej i służby państwowe is a dataset listed in Geoportal Poland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapy.geoportal.gov.pl. The Public Utility Services and State Services collection was created as a result of harmonization of data from the Topographic Object Database (BDOT10k). The data has been transformed according to the INSPIRE model. Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Utility and government services" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2016-07-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-pl.
